name: 30528-sharegpt-gptoss120b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine; the whole 61 GB checkpoint sits on one 80 GB card.
architecture: 117B-parameter sparse mixture-of-experts decoder, MXFP4 expert weights, 36 layers, 128 experts with 4 active per token, ~61 GB of checkpoint.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 6%, no cooldown, bounded at 1000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. 8 streams equals the engine's `--max-num-seqs 8`. Warmup comes out of the bound rather than on top of it, so roughly 60 requests warm the engine and the remaining ~940 are measured; both counts are approximate and are not a row range of the request file. Seed static 30528.
workload: a ShareGPT V3 draw materialised row for row into `configs/data/sharegpt-1000-gptoss120b.jsonl` (1000 rows) by `configs/data/make-dataset.py`, tokenised with this model's own tokenizer; it totals 215312 prompt tokens and 199033 output tokens. Prompts mean 215 tokens (p10 9, p50 85, p90 620, max 1013), replies mean 199 tokens (p10 10, p50 147, p90 480, max 1011). Each row carries its reply's own token length as `output_tokens_count`, so the backend sets `ignore_eos` and generation runs to exactly that many tokens. Raw completions (`request_format: plain`), temperature 0.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on a 120-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, serving eight concurrent conversations on one GPU.
launch:
model: openai/gpt-oss-120b
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 8
enable-prefix-caching: false

# HARDWARE-FORCED. On 80 GB the ~61 GB of weights leave roughly 11 GB for KV, and the
# checkpoint's own max_position_embeddings of 131072 would not fit a single sequence in it.
max-model-len: 4096

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
